official_identity: The current Indian Health Service Pine Ridge Service Unit page identifies Pine Ridge Hospital/PHS Indian Health Service in Pine Ridge, South Dakota and describes its 45-bed hospital services.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership and exact facility/city/state/ZIP agreement with the current IHS hospital page support the federal scope disposition. This is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
